$comment: Bundled defaults for oh-my-copilot-slim (lowest-precedence config layer; override in $COPILOT_HOME/oh-my-copilot-slim.json or <repo>/.github/oh-my-copilot-slim.json). 'presets' keeps the upstream oh-my-opencode-slim preset shape; the 'github-copilot/' model prefix is stripped for native Copilot. A preset may 'extends' one parent preset; 'model' may be a fallback chain (array of ids or {id, variant}). The active preset's model/effort is applied as a live per-session subagent override where it differs from agents/*.agent.md (apply_preset: auto|off). Upstream schema (informational, not loaded): https://unpkg.com/oh-my-opencode-slim@latest/oh-my-opencode-slim.schema.json. The 'codegraph' MCP server is bundled by the plugin (plugin.json mcpServers, @colbymchenry/codegraph@1.6.2). See docs/configuration.md.
